title: Sweet Algerian Date Tagine
description: A traditional Indian-inspired tagine dish using sweet and flavorful Algerian ingredients.
instructions: Heat the coconut oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the ginger powder, cinnamon powder, and cardamom powder, and cook for 1 minute.
Add the Algerian dates and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until they start to soften.
Pour in the almond milk, adding the sugar and salt. Stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 10-15 minutes, or until the sauce has thickened.
Stir in the tagine spice blend and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve over rice or with naan bread.
